context.purpose: Reduce named dimensions of one captured classic NetCDF measurement cube to a coordinate-labelled profile with inclusive numeric range selection, asserted units and an explicit missing-value policy, published as a smaller NetCDF, a numeric CSV and a hashed summary.
context.assumptions: Unweighted arithmetic mean of selected binary64 cells; strictly increasing finite double coordinates with declared units; dimensions declared in exact storage order; isolated xarray 2026.9.0 with SciPy 1.18.1 and NumPy 2.5.4 (engine scipy), one serial process.
context.constraints: CDF-1 only, at most 4 MiB, 4 dimensions, 4096 values per axis, 262144 cells, 2-2048 profile points, magnitudes within 1e100, attribute allowlist units/_FillValue/long_name/title, one double variable and its coordinates.
context.inspection: Inspect profile.nc, profile.csv and xarray-summary.json (source, axis and selection hashes, valid and missing counts, tolerance model).
context.recovery: Correct located contract, structure, unit, coordinate, range and missing-policy faults; ill-conditioned or all-missing profiles are refused, not published; permuted storage order must be declared as stored. To plot the profile use the workflow example with Gnuplot source {"$artifact": id, "index": 1}; a propagate profile with an empty mean is refused by the consumer.

workflow.scope: The verified profile.nc file artifact can feed another xarray reduction; profile.csv (index 1, table) feeds the Gnuplot route through an authored {"$artifact": ..., "index": 1} workflow edge with byte-identical capture, normal workflow verification and independent chart checks (Gnuplot 6.0.2 locally, older than its absorbed 6.0.5, so not a source-current Gnuplot qualification).

composition.scope: Shared references, expressions and finite studies resolve to the same literal reduction contract.

lifecycle.timeout: Single total deadline (default 120 s) over host validation, both native stages and host verification; native CPU 120 s, address space 4 GiB, 64 MiB per file.
lifecycle.cancellation: Owned process-group cancellation through the shared runner and a pre-publication check.
lifecycle.logs: Captured source.nc, authored/plan/native configuration, worker and implementation fingerprints, consumed-input bindings, submissions, stdout/stderr, native result and readback record.
lifecycle.verification: Independent standard-library bounded CDF-1 reader; Fraction/fsum oracle with a stated scale-aware tolerance; every coordinate, value, unit, count, attribute, CSV byte and summary field recomputed by saved verification.

losses: Only the allowlisted attributes; no record dimension, packing, calendars, strings or other variables.
data.scope: Regular local capture <=4 MiB; complete independent host decoding before native launch.

losses: Unweighted mean only; units and allowlisted long_name/title preserved, other metadata never copied.

traits.missing: empty mean cell under propagate only

losses: Units are declared by the consumer, not in the file; shortest round-trip decimal text.
data.scope: 2-2048 rows; Gnuplot needs a no-missing profile; consumed through a workflow $artifact (index 1) edge.

inspection.scope: Inspect profile.csv, xarray-summary.json and the NetCDF publication.
inspection.limits: No interactive native session or plot.

authoring.reuse: Source byte digest participates in reuse identity; same-path edits invalidate reuse.

mpi.scope: One serial process; no MPI or Dask.

time-batches.scope: No time-list batches; use finite document studies.

live-editing.scope: No persistent native state or reverse editing.

conversion.scope: No format conversion, regridding or interpolation; the route reduces one classic NetCDF cube.

native-save.scope: xarray has no application document to save; publications are inspectable NetCDF/CSV/JSON only (no pickle).

workflow.scope: profile.nc (file) and profile.csv (table, index 1) hand off by index; profile.csv feeds the Gnuplot route in examples/schemaxis/xarray-profile-plot-workflow.json.

source-authoring.scope: Editable variable, coordinate, range, retained dimension and missing-policy declarations with undo through common authoring.

property-authoring.scope: Nested coordinate, range and missing fields are editable forms.

cases.scope: Dyadic analytic cube v=280+5*depthIndex+0.5*timeIndex+0.25*stationIndex; means over time and station are exactly 280.625+5*depthIndex with 6 valid cells each.
Time [0,1] and depth [0,20] with skip and minimumValid 2; exact rational means of the valid cells with counts 4,3,3 valid and 0,1,1 missing.

completion.scope: Initial reduceProfile route (allocation 66, host and bounded native acceptance pending parent review): all fields, bounded CDF-1 reader, units/order/coordinate/range/missing-policy contract, native xarray scipy engine, independent verification, Gnuplot CSV handoff.
